infobox.usage: Allows access to The Lab location a single time.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs access keycard (Access) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A single-use United Security-issued TerraGroup Labs access keycard.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Will be consumed upon entering The Lab. Will not be consumed in the practice and practice co-op game modes.
  - When playing in a group, all players need their own.
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 2 need to be found in raid for the quest Fishing Place

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as initial equipment from Beneath The Streets
- 1 can be obtained as initial equipment from Quality Standard
- 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from Chemical - Part 4
- 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from Camera, Action!

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In the Common fund stash
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
- On Bosses
- In Rare valuables crates

sections.heading: Hideout Cultist Circle
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained with a special sacrifice

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- In the "marked room" at the abandoned factory
- In the "marked room" at Chekannaya 13
